name: Nubia
uniques: Receive triple Gold from Barbarian encampments and pillaging Cities
startIntroPart1: Mighty Taharqa, King of Kush, ruler of the Black Pharaohs! Your ancestors conquered Egypt itself and ruled as pharaohs of the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty, uniting the Nile from Meroe to the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: The archers of Nubia are feared across the desert, and your smiths forge iron before any of your neighbors. Rebuild the Land of the Bow and let Meroe rise again!
declaringWar: Our arrows will darken your sky before our warriors ever reach your walls.
attacked: You have loosed the lion of the Nile. Now face its bow.
defeated: Kerma falls silent... but the river remembers.
introduction: I am Taharqa, King of Kush and Pharaoh of the Two Lands. Speak your business.
neutralHello: The Nile flows long. What do you seek?
hateHello: Choose your next words carefully, stranger.
tradeRequest: Gold for gold, iron for grain - a fair trade for both our peoples.

name: Gauls
uniques: [+15]% Strength for units fighting in [Friendly Land]
Gain [50] Influence with a [City-State] every time you fight a [Barbarian]
startIntroPart1: Vercingetorix, chieftain of the Arverni, greets you! Your tribes have long roamed the forests and rivers between the Rhine and the great western ocean.
startIntroPart2: Though Rome once forced its yoke upon your people at Alesia, the spirit of the Gauls was never broken. Unite the tribes and let Gaul stand free once more!
declaringWar: Our chariots will trample your fields before the next moon.
attacked: You wake a people who broke bread with wolves. This was unwise.
defeated: Alesia has fallen once before. It will not be forgotten.
introduction: I am Vercingetorix, chosen chieftain of a free people. Speak plainly.
neutralHello: The forests are watching. State your purpose.
hateHello: You test my patience, and my patience is short.
tradeRequest: Iron, wine, or grain - name it and we shall see if it is fair.

name: Phoenicia
startIntroPart1: Hail Hiram, King of Tyre! From your narrow strip of coast, your ships carried purple dye, cedar wood, and the alphabet itself to every shore of the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: No sea was too distant for a Phoenician keel, no market too far for a Phoenician trader. Set sail once more and let your colonies span the world!
declaringWar: Our fleets have already blockaded your harbors. Surrender now.
attacked: You have angered the masters of the sea. Every port will turn against you.
defeated: Tyre's walls have broken, but our ships have already sailed beyond your reach.
introduction: I am Hiram, King of Tyre. Let us speak of trade, not war.
neutralHello: The tides bring many visitors. What brings you?
hateHello: Our patience, like our purple dye, is rare and nearly spent.
tradeRequest: A fair exchange benefits every port it touches.

name: Sumer
startIntroPart1: Gilgamesh, King of Uruk, two-thirds god and one-third man! Between the Tigris and Euphrates, your people invented writing, the wheel, and the first codes of law.
startIntroPart2: Every city that has ever risen owes a debt to Sumer. Build the ziggurats anew and let the cradle of civilization bear its final fruit!
declaringWar: The tablets have already recorded your defeat.
attacked: Even Humbaba feared to challenge Uruk. You will learn why.
defeated: Uruk's walls, built by my own hands, could not hold forever.
introduction: I am Gilgamesh, King of Uruk. Wisdom favors those who listen.
neutralHello: The reeds along the river whisper of visitors. Speak.
hateHello: Enkidu is no longer here to restrain my temper.
tradeRequest: Barley for bronze - a bargain older than memory.

name: Numidia
uniques: [-33]% maintenance costs for buildings [in this city]
startIntroPart1: Masinissa, King of the Numidians, master of the finest horsemen in the ancient world! Your cavalry decided the fate of empires, riding without saddle or bridle across the plains of North Africa.
startIntroPart2: Once courted by Carthage and Rome alike, your people know the price of divided loyalty. Unite the tribes of the Atlas and ride to glory on your own terms!
declaringWar: Our horsemen are already circling your borders.
attacked: You have chosen to fight the finest riders beneath the sun. A grave error.
defeated: Even the swiftest horse cannot outrun every empire.
introduction: I am Masinissa, King of Numidia. Ride with me, or stand aside.
neutralHello: The Atlas foothills welcome few strangers. What do you want?
hateHello: My cavalry grows restless. Speak quickly.
tradeRequest: Horses for grain, friend - both our peoples profit.

name: Armenia
uniques: [+1] Happiness from each type of luxury resource
[-25]% Culture cost of natural border growth [in this city]
startIntroPart1: Tigranes the Great, King of Kings, ruler of Armenia! From your highland fortresses between three seas, your empire once stretched from the Caspian to the Mediterranean.
startIntroPart2: The mountains have sheltered your people through every storm of history. Raise the highland kingdom again and let it stand eternal among the peaks!
declaringWar: The mountain passes are ours. You will not cross them unchallenged.
attacked: You march against the roof of the world. Few who try succeed.
defeated: Even the highest peak erodes given enough time.
introduction: I am Tigranes, King of Kings. The mountains grant you an audience.
neutralHello: The highlands are quiet today. What brings you here?
hateHello: The passes can close as easily as they opened.
tradeRequest: A trade agreement as solid as our mountain fortresses.

name: Georgia
startIntroPart1: Queen Tamar the Great, sovereign of Georgia! Under your reign, your kingdom reached its golden age, stretching from the Black Sea to the shores of the Caspian.
startIntroPart2: Poets, builders, and warriors all flourished under your crown at the crossroads of Europe and Asia. Bring back the golden age and let Georgia shine once more!
declaringWar: The lion of Georgia does not warn twice.
attacked: You have chosen war with a golden age. Prepare for winter.
defeated: Our mountains held for centuries. Today, they did not hold.
introduction: I am Tamar, King of Kings and Queen of Queens of Georgia. Welcome.
neutralHello: The Caucasus greets travelers cautiously. Speak your purpose.
hateHello: My patience is a mountain pass - narrow, and easily closed.
tradeRequest: Silk and wine for what you offer - shall we agree?

name: Bulgaria
startIntroPart1: Khan Asparuh, founder of the first Bulgarian state! Crossing the Danube, your horsemen carved a lasting kingdom from the frontier of two crumbling empires.
startIntroPart2: For centuries your khanate stood as a bridge and a battleground between East and West. Cross the river once more and found a realm that endures!
declaringWar: The Danube has already carried word of your doom.
attacked: We crossed a mighty river to build our home. We will not be moved.
defeated: Pliska burns, but the khanate's memory does not.
introduction: I am Asparuh, Khan of the Bulgarians. Speak, traveler.
neutralHello: The steppe winds bring news of you. What is your business?
hateHello: My riders grow impatient at your delay.
tradeRequest: Grain and horses - a fair exchange between neighbors.

name: Hungary
uniques: Units gain [50]% more Experience from combat
startIntroPart1: King Matthias Corvinus, the Just, ruler of Hungary! Your legendary Black Army made your small kingdom one of the most feared powers in Central Europe.
startIntroPart2: From the Carpathian basin, your court became a beacon of Renaissance learning while your soldiers guarded the gates of Christendom. Rebuild the black army and let Hungary rise again!
declaringWar: The Black Army marches, and it does not retreat.
attacked: You have drawn the sword against the Just King. That was your last mistake.
defeated: Buda's library may burn, but Hungarian steel remembers.
introduction: I am Matthias Corvinus, King of Hungary. State your business, and be just about it.
neutralHello: The Danube plain welcomes cautious travelers. What do you seek?
hateHello: My mercenaries are paid whether they fight or wait. Choose quickly.
tradeRequest: A just trade, as befits a just king.

name: Zulu
uniques: Land units cost only 1 movement to disembark
startIntroPart1: Shaka, King of the Zulu, forger of the mighty impi regiments! You reshaped the art of war across southern Africa, discarding the throwing spear for the short iklwa and the deadly discipline of the buffalo horn formation.
startIntroPart2: In little more than a decade you built a nation from a small clan through sheer force of will and tactical genius. Raise the impi once more and let the horns of the buffalo encircle the world!
declaringWar: The horns of the buffalo are closing around you already.
attacked: You have chosen to fight the architect of the impi. Few survive that choice.
defeated: The horns have been cut, but the buffalo will calve again.
introduction: I am Shaka, King of the Zulu nation. Speak with respect, or not at all.
neutralHello: The plains are ours to watch. What is your purpose here?
hateHello: My impi await only my word.
tradeRequest: Cattle for cattle, or something of equal worth - shall we agree?

name: Abbasids
startIntroPart1: Harun al-Rashid, Commander of the Faithful, ruler of the Abbasid Caliphate! From your round city of Baghdad, scholars, poets, and mathematicians gathered from every corner of the known world.
startIntroPart2: The House of Wisdom translated the learning of Greece, Persia, and India into a golden age unmatched in its time. Rebuild Baghdad and let knowledge once again flow down the Tigris!
declaringWar: The armies of the Caliphate do not ask twice for submission.
attacked: You raise your hand against the Commander of the Faithful. Reflect on that choice.
defeated: Baghdad's library may burn, but its knowledge has already spread beyond your reach.
introduction: I am Harun al-Rashid, Caliph of Baghdad. Peace be upon you - speak your purpose.
neutralHello: The caravans of Baghdad welcome many travelers. What brings you?
hateHello: My viziers grow impatient. State your business swiftly.
tradeRequest: Silk, spice, or knowledge - Baghdad trades fairly with all.

name: Mali
uniques: [+20]% Gold from Cities connected to Capital
startIntroPart1: Mansa Musa, ruler of Mali, richest man the world had ever known! Your pilgrimage to Mecca scattered so much gold across Cairo that its value collapsed for a decade.
startIntroPart2: Timbuktu became a beacon of scholarship and trade, its salt and gold caravans crossing the whole of the Sahara. Fill the treasury once more and let the world marvel at Mali's wealth!
declaringWar: Gold has already bought the loyalty of armies at your gates.
attacked: You would rob the richest treasury in the world? Bold, and foolish.
defeated: Our gold outlasts us - it will simply fund whoever rises next.
introduction: I am Mansa Musa, Lord of Mali. Let us speak of trade, as befits wealthy men.
neutralHello: The salt caravans bring travelers of every kind. What do you seek?
hateHello: Even my patience has a price, and you are close to exhausting it.
tradeRequest: Gold for salt, salt for gold - Mali profits from either.

name: Khmer
startIntroPart1: Jayavarman VII, King of Kings, builder of Angkor Thom! Your engineers tamed the monsoon itself, building vast reservoirs, or barays, that let your rice fields feed a mighty empire.
startIntroPart2: Temple-mountains rose from the jungle to touch the heavens under your rule. Restore the waters of the baray and let Angkor's towers rise once more!
declaringWar: The waters of the baray now serve only our armies, not yours.
attacked: The jungle has swallowed greater threats than you.
defeated: The stones of Angkor will outlast every conqueror who claims them.
introduction: I am Jayavarman VII, King of the Khmer. Speak, and be welcome beneath the towers.
neutralHello: The temple bells have announced your arrival. What is your purpose?
hateHello: The monsoon season is short, and so is my patience.
tradeRequest: Rice and stone, silk and spice - shall we find fair terms?

name: Kongo
startIntroPart1: Afonso I, Manikongo, ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo! Your capital at Mbanza Kongo grew into a great city of stone churches and bustling markets along the Congo River basin.
startIntroPart2: Your kingdom balanced ancient tradition with new ideas from distant shores, forging a realm respected across the Atlantic. Restore the balance of the cosmogram and let Kongo flourish once more!
declaringWar: The ancestors have already judged you, and found you wanting.
attacked: Our copper and iron do not only make ornaments - they make spearheads too.
defeated: Mbanza Kongo falls, but the river remembers every kingdom upon it.
introduction: I am Afonso, Manikongo of the Kongo. Speak, and speak honestly.
neutralHello: The markets of Mbanza Kongo are open to honest traders. What do you seek?
hateHello: The ancestors watch how you conduct yourself here.
tradeRequest: Copper, ivory, cloth - name a fair exchange.

name: Timurids
startIntroPart1: Timur, conqueror of Samarkand, terror of Delhi and Damascus! Your armies swept from the steppe to the Mediterranean, leaving both ruin and magnificent monuments in their wake.
startIntroPart2: Samarkand became a jewel of Islamic architecture, its domes gleaming with the plunder and patronage of a world-spanning conquest. Rebuild the empire and let Samarkand's turquoise domes rise again!
declaringWar: The steppe remembers no mercy, and neither do I.
attacked: You have summoned a storm that has broken empires far greater than yours.
defeated: Samarkand's domes will stand long after this defeat is forgotten.
introduction: I am Timur, Lord of the Timurid realm. Kneel, or state your business quickly.
neutralHello: My armies rarely pause for idle talk. What do you want?
hateHello: You test the patience of a man who has broken sultanates.
tradeRequest: Even conquerors need silk and horses. Let us trade.

name: Seljuks
startIntroPart1: Alp Arslan, the Heroic Lion, Sultan of the Seljuks! Your victory at Manzikert shattered the armies of Byzantium and opened Anatolia to Turkic settlement forever.
startIntroPart2: From the steppes of Central Asia, your horsemen carved a realm stretching from the Aral Sea to the Mediterranean coast. Ride again and let the Seljuk banner fly from Isfahan to Anatolia!
declaringWar: Our horsemen have already broken greater armies than yours at Manzikert.
attacked: You challenge the Heroic Lion. Few who tried lived to regret it slowly.
defeated: Even a lion tires eventually - but the herd remembers his roar.
introduction: I am Alp Arslan, Sultan of the Seljuks. Speak plainly, rider to rider.
neutralHello: The steppe wind carries word of visitors. What is your purpose?
hateHello: My ghazis are eager for battle. Do not keep them waiting.
tradeRequest: Horses and steel for silk and grain - a fair trade between realms.

name: Aksum
uniques: [+15]% Gold from trade routes to a different Civilization
startIntroPart1: King Ezana, ruler of Aksum, master of the Red Sea trade! Your merchant fleets linked the highlands of Africa with Rome, Persia, and India, and your kingdom minted its own gold coinage.
startIntroPart2: Towering stelae still mark the graves of your ancestors, monuments no other African kingdom of your age could match. Restore the fleets of the Red Sea and let Aksum's stone towers rise anew!
declaringWar: Our fleets already command the waters you depend upon.
attacked: You choose war against the masters of the Red Sea trade. A costly choice.
defeated: The stelae will stand watch long after this defeat fades from memory.
introduction: I am Ezana, King of Aksum. Welcome - let us speak as traders, not enemies.
neutralHello: The Red Sea winds bring many travelers. State your business.
hateHello: My patience runs as dry as the highland dry season.
tradeRequest: Ivory, gold, and salt - Aksum trades fairly with distant lands.

name: Tibet
startIntroPart1: Songtsen Gampo, unifier of Tibet, founder of the empire of the high plateau! From the roof of the world, your armies once reached into China, Nepal, and Central Asia.
startIntroPart2: Buddhism took deep root in your kingdom, and Lhasa grew into a sacred city among the clouds. Unite the plateau once more and let Tibet's spiritual light shine across Asia!
declaringWar: The mountains have already chosen their side, and it is not yours.
attacked: Few armies survive the thin air and thinner patience of the highlands.
defeated: Lhasa's monasteries close their gates, but the plateau endures forever.
introduction: I am Songtsen Gampo, King of Tibet. Welcome to the roof of the world.
neutralHello: The mountain winds carry word of travelers. What is your purpose?
hateHello: The passes can close as quickly as they opened for you.
tradeRequest: Salt, wool, and tea - fair trade for a fair traveler.

name: Dai Viet
startIntroPart1: Ly Thai To, founder of the Ly dynasty, who moved the capital to the soaring dragon of Thang Long! Your kingdom's rice deltas fed a resilient people who repelled invasion after invasion.
startIntroPart2: From the Red River delta, Dai Viet forged an identity strong enough to outlast a thousand years of northern rule. Rebuild Thang Long and let the dragon rise again!
declaringWar: The delta has swallowed greater armies than yours before the wet season ends.
attacked: A thousand years under a foreign yoke could not break us. You will not either.
defeated: Thang Long bends, as bamboo bends, and will rise again after the storm.
introduction: I am Ly Thai To, founder of the Ly dynasty. Welcome to the land of the ascending dragon.
neutralHello: The river delta welcomes travelers with an open hand. What do you seek?
hateHello: The bamboo bends, but do not mistake that for weakness.
tradeRequest: Rice and silk for what you offer - shall we agree on fair terms?

name: Scythians
uniques: Horses provide double quantity of resources
startIntroPart1: Ateas, King of the Scythians, master of the endless steppe! Your horse-archers could shoot with deadly accuracy at full gallop, a skill that terrified every settled empire from Persia to Greece.
startIntroPart2: Your people carried gold and skill across the grasslands from the Danube to the borders of China, leaving burial mounds filled with treasures fit for kings. Ride out once more and let the steppe belong to the Scythians again!
declaringWar: Our arrows fly true even at a full gallop. Yours will not find us so easily.
attacked: The steppe swallows armies whole. Yours will be no exception.
defeated: The wind on the steppe forgets no one - not even our conquerors.
introduction: I am Ateas, King of the Scythians. Speak quickly, for my horse does not like to stand still.
neutralHello: The grass of the steppe bends for many travelers. What brings you?
hateHello: My riders circle already. Choose your words with care.
tradeRequest: Horses and gold for grain and bronze - a fair trade of the steppe.
